d:
The HONOR Robot Phone is probably the most interesting smartphone I've used this year. With a built-in gimbal camera, subject tracking, cinematic motion shots, ARRI collaboration, multiple shooting modes and proper flagship hardware underneath, this is much more than a gimmick.
After spending time with it, here's my look at what the Robot Phone can actually do... and whether HONOR has built something genuinely useful or just something cool to show off.
